units: <cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Ruth 1:20">Targ. Ruth I, 20</cite>; a. fr.—

<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 46:3">Gen. R. s. 46</cite> (homiletic etymology, ref. to <cite ref="Genesis 17:1">Gen. XVII, 1</cite>) <he>אני הוא שאמרתי … דַּי</he> it is I who said to my world …, ‘it is enough’.

<cite ref="Sukkah 5a:3">Succ. 5ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Job 26:9">Job XXVI, 9</cite>) <he>שפירש ש׳ מזיו וכ׳</he> the Almighty separated himself from the splendor of his residence, with his cloud over him; a. e.
